identity: Concerto for alto saxophone, with band original and piano version
findings: Norbert Nozy's University of Liège interview dates the concerto 1993 and says it was written for his recording with the Royal Band of the Belgian Guides.
The Guides' official discography identifies Nozy as soloist, Walter Boeykens as conductor, and Concerto for Alto Saxophone and Symphonic Band on CD 8.
Archived 2006 Dinant competition rules include the work among pieces performed with piano and name Lantro Music.
